title: Twist and scalar-comparison maps are coherent in a field tower
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $S$ be a scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $E\subset F\subset G$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, let $m\in\mathbf Z$, and let $C\in D^b_c(S,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Write $R_H=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{H,S}$ for $H=E,F,G$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and $\operatorname{Ext}_{H'/H}$ for the completed scalar-extension functor [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Identify its value on complete objects with ordinary derived change of rings using the specified natural map $\chi$ of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Let $a_C:\operatorname{Ext}_{G/F}\operatorname{Ext}_{F/E}C\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Ext}_{G/E}C$ be the map transported by $\chi$ from ordinary tensor associativity. Let $\beta_{H'/H,C}:\operatorname{Ext}_{H'/H}(C(m))\xrightarrow{\sim}(\operatorname{Ext}_{H'/H}C)(m)$ be the twist comparison of [lem-weil-integral-twist-derived-scalar]. Then these maps satisfy
$$
 (a_C)(m)\circ\beta_{G/F,\operatorname{Ext}_{F/E}C}\circ\operatorname{Ext}_{G/F}(\beta_{F/E,C})
 =\beta_{G/E,C}\circ a_{C(m)}.
$$
On a K-flat flat-term representative $P\to C$, both paths are represented, under the specified comparisons, by $(x\otimes l)\otimes b\otimes c\mapsto(x\otimes bc)\otimes(l\otimes1)$. The identity-extension comparisons are the tensor unit maps. After rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], $a_C$ agrees with the scalar-extension composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition].
